label: batch-56
tail:
**Batch 56 is authored.** The A/B pages, 10 item carriers, manifest, coverage, proof contracts, notes, and cross-batch input are complete. I added the K-fold covariance lemma and extended the risk theorem to cover weighted split schedules, holdout, and finite independent randomization. All 10 Step 1 readiness records are current and closed; these records are not independent approval.

Scoped checks passed: precheck (7 proofs), proof contracts (7), proof layout (7 items, 26 steps, no defects), rendercheck (12 files), focused dependency check (10 items, no errors), content policy (10 items, no errors), and source-fetch check (3/3). The batch-local dependency calculation found no cycles or level mismatches; maximum level is 3.

The full-run item-level check still reports 63 empty page inventories in other batches, and the shared batch dependency artifact is stale after manifest changes. I left shared run state untouched for the owner/engine to refresh. The ISLR PDF matched its stored byte count and hash, though MuPDF reports 441 pages while the stored stamp says 464; I recorded the discrepancy without changing the stamp.

The relevant sections were inspected in the [Arlot–Celisse survey](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0907.4728), [ISLR Chapter 5](https://www.statlearning.com/s/ISLR-Seventh-Printing.pdf), and [Bengio–Grandvalet paper](https://jmlr.org/papers/volume5/grandvalet04a/grandvalet04a.pdf).
